report:
I cannot identify any specific objective or domain from this evidence.

Rationale:
- The difference is overwhelmingly concentrated at the very first token (position 0) across nearly all layers, suggesting a change in how the BOS/first-token context is handled rather than a downstream behavioral objective.
- The logit-lens top tokens are an eclectic mix: acronyms/proper nouns (TMZ, DJI, HDTV, MPEG, Playboy), generic header-like words (Summary, Outcome, File, Students, Maximum), assorted nouns/adjectives (reefs, scammers, marketers), and some negative/taboo words (hate, graves, cannibal, herpes). This lacks a coherent thematic domain or instruction/safety signature.
- Positions 1–4 similarly feature many Titlecase/acronym tokens (Waiter, Summary, Outcome, Playboy, HDTV, File, Computation) mixed with unrelated fragments (astrolog, hay), pointing more to a superficial capitalization/acronym bias than a clear objective.
- Patchscope readouts are not provided, so there’s no behavioral confirmation.

At most, Model B seems slightly more biased toward capitalized/acronym/proper-noun tokens early in sequences, but that does not support naming a specific training objective or domain difference.
